title: Customer profile carrying both a preferences object and a legacy flat preferences_theme column
rationale: The direct NP-021 sentinel in realistic clothing: a document mid-migration where the flat legacy column and the new nested field would have produced the identical flattened key under pre-2.0 concatenation. If FlattenedPath escaping regresses, these two fields collide into one and this is the first thing to go red.
catchesBugClass: Loss of injectivity in the key encoding, plus the quadratic prefix-grouping blowup that ambiguity caused. Also catches an escape/unescape asymmetry.
cannotCatch: It only exercises the single-character separator. The multi-character case has its own documented hazard which this cannot reach, and which quickReconstruct cannot test at all because it hardcodes the default separator.

predicted.detail: The nested path encodes to two segments joined by the separator while the literal legacy field encodes to one segment with the separator escaped; decodeSegments splits only on unescaped separators.
